Albay Provincial Ordinances — index of the codified provincial codes

_completeness: Partial. This is not a complete index of Albay provincial ordinances. The Sangguniang Panlalawigan does not publish a machine-readable register of its ordinances and albay.gov.ph is not retrievable by automated clients. The six records below are the ones whose ordinance number and official title could be established from a retrievable primary source.
_completeness_note: The index of codified provincial codes also lists a Tax Code, Traffic Safety Code, Fishery Code, G.A.D. Code and Tourism Code. Their enacted texts were never archived and no ordinance number or session date is therefore published for them.
_caveats: A session date is stated only where the source document names the session and its date. Where a source cites an ordinance without dating it, sessionDate is null and the table shows “Not published” rather than an inferred date.
Ordinance No. 005-99 also appears in the sources as “Provincial Ordinance No. 05-99”. It is recorded once, under the fuller form.

The Environment Code source prints its enacting clause as “AN ORDINANCE ENACTINGTHE PROVINCIAL ENVIRONMENT CODE”. The missing space is a typographic error in the original and has been normalised; no wording was changed.
Titles reproduce the wording and punctuation of the source, except that all-capital enacting clauses have been converted to sentence case for readability.
These are historical records of enactment, not a statement of what is currently in force. Verify any ordinance against the Sangguniang Panlalawigan or the Provincial Secretary before relying on it.
